input.quote: AbbVie shall have the sole right to invoice and book sales, establish all terms of sale (including pricing and discounts) and warehousing, and distribute the Licensed Products in the Territory
input.rationale: No most-favoured-nation or "best terms" obligation is imposed on us anywhere in the agreement. Searches for MFN-style language (most favored/favoured, no less favorable, as favorable as, best price, matching third-party terms/offers) returned nothing, and the commercial articles run the other way: under Section 4.3 AbbVie has the sole right to establish all terms of sale, including pricing and discounts, and Article 6 payments plus the Section 6.5.3 royalty reductions operate in our favour. The closest third-party-terms mechanic, Section 5.9.3 (Proposed Future In-Licensed Rights), is an elective opt-in under which we choose whether to take a sublicense and only then accept its terms — it does not require us to extend Harpoon any terms given to others. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer), so no redline is proposed.
